_comment: Chapter 04: the bounds every role file must sit inside, and the rollout order. learnBounds are Microsoft's: activation from 1 to 24 hours on the role settings page, but at most 8 hours on the PIM API overview; the stricter, 8 hours, is used. tierCaps are the program's (Book 04, Appendix B; Design guidance). activeMaximumDuration in the role files (P15D) is the program's placeholder for 'the shortest period the documented exception needs'; set it per exception. The rollout follows the project plan: one role class first (decision D-A5 picks it; Tier 1 is shown), then every tier, one wave at a time. A wave is refused until every earlier wave matches its files.

rollout.name: Pilot class (plan Phase 2, A2.1 and A2.2; decision D-A5)
